messages:
maria: Postmortem up for the daytime spike — cross-region LB retries during the blue/green rollout. Root cause looks like a routing fallback loop + stale TLS cache. Need owners for follow-ups and a fast remediation plan. TL;DR in the doc: INF-4821 noted a routing mismatch, INF-4823 shows repeated TLS handshake resets.
samir: I can take the routing side. I'll triage INF-4821 and propose a config patch. ETA 48h for a PR and test.
henry: I'll own monitoring + alerting. Add a metric for per-region retry-rate and an automated pager if >5% for 5m. Putting draft alert in #eng-sre.
nina: I'll look at TLS cache/rotation flow (INF-4823). Suspect cert rotation race and cache expiry mismatch. Will instrument handshake metrics and verify HSM KMS timestamps.
maria: Thanks — can everyone drop the followup ticket IDs in this thread? We want a concise action list for the exec update.
samir: INF-4890 — routing-constant-fallback (my working ticket). Steps: 1) reproduce with regional sim harness, 2) kernel of fix: prefer local LB route if KV cached mapping exists, 3) add unit/integration test, 4) staged rollout.
henry: INF-4891 — retry-alerts-ownership. Dashboard items: retry-rate by region, TLS-handshake-failures, 95th tail p99 latency. I'll tag on SLO impact baseline.
nina: INF-4892 — tls-cache-rotation. Quick mitigation: add backoff on rotation, extend cache TTL by 30s in the short term. Long-term: make rotation atomic across backends.
leo: I'll run a targeted canary in eu-west-1 and us-west-2 after Samir's patch lands. Can start validation load Tuesday.
maria: Timeline proposal: immediate mitigations within 24h (config TTL bump + alerting), routing patch in 48–72h, full atomic rotation path in 2 weeks. Is that realistic?
samir: 48–72h ok for the patch but need someone to sign off on the staged rollout window. ops-bot, can you block parallel deploys to the gateway during the deploy window?
ops-bot: @samir Sure — I'll create a deploy freeze window resource for the patch and notify release-war-room.
henry: I'll add a synthetic probe to exercise cross-region TLS and surface handshake resets. Probe config: curl --resolve and explicit SNI, run every 1m. If handshake fails 3x in 5m fire page.
nina: Quick note — logs show the TLS resets correlate with a GC spike on some control-plane nodes. Adding GC tagging to the TLS library now.
maria: Ownership summary for exec: Samir -> INF-4890 (routing fix) target PR in 48h, Nina -> INF-4892 (TLS rotation) short-term mitigations in 24h, Henry -> INF-4891 (alerts/dashboard) in 24h, Leo -> validation & canary. I'll produce the follow-up ETA doc for customers.
samir: I'll post the config diff here when ready. small snippet: ```diff -- a/lb.conf b/lb.conf
@@ -22,7 +22,7 @@
- route_fallback = "global"
+ route_fallback = "local_prefer"
 ttl_seconds = 15  # temporary bump
```
maria: Good. Add a quick comment in the PR linking the postmortem so oncall knows why it's urgent.
henry: Putting the alert runbook in the ticket: steps to mitigate -> revert route change -> scale down canary -> contact infra.
leo: After the patch I'll run the chaos tests: network partition + cert rotation during high load. Will paste results into INF-4890.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up sync in 72h (2002005999) with owners [samir, nina, henry, leo, maria]. Will post notes recap. :bell:
maria: Thanks all. Let's aim for short status updates in the tickets every 24h until resolved. If anyone hits a blocker call me directly. :thumbsup:
